notes.title: v0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where character-specific volume controls in the settings were not working.
[*] Improved UI visibility on save/load screens.
[*] A bug that allowed you to revert your selection via the backlog has been fixed. From now on, the content before you make a selection will only be saved as normal logs.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when closing a pop-up window by pressing ESC.
[*] Removed the shading on the selection buttons and fixed them to initialize and reorder based on the mouse cursor position.
[*] Fixed some dialogue and dubbing errors in Raul’s scenario.
[*] System UI terminology has been revised for each supported language.
[*] Some improvements to translations in Russian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian. For localization, we will continue to make improvements through updates. Please give us your feedback!
[*] Some sound effects have been added to Raul's and Tyrineon's scenario.[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where Tyrineon's character voice was out of sync.

notes.title: Luna's Twilight Early Access Now Available
notes.notes:
NearDream's otome fantasy romance visual novel, Luna's Twilight is now available on Steam Early Access.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-poMeoR3NoA

In a remote mansion deep in a silent forest, four men of different races whisper words of love to you.

Meet Raul, an honest and straightforward werewolf, and Tyrineon, a beautiful elf with a gentle and kind demeanor.

During the 2-3 months of Early Access period, we look forward to listen your opinions to see if there are any issues with the quality of the current scenario or the convenience of the game.

Additional scenarios of Shade, a proud and arrogant vampire, and Al Feouz, a small, endearing draconic boy will be available upon full release.

We'll be waiting for you in Luna's Twilight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103170
